product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Lattice-Patterned Stoneware Planter, 6.3"H, Gray and White
product.description: Display your favorite plant in style with this visually engaging stoneware planter. Perfect for houseplants and succulents, this planter will provide the perfect finishing touch to your modern-style home decor, and its stoneware construction is durable and sturdy. 7.48" diameter x 6.3"H 100% stoneware Bring this durable stoneware planter to life with colorful flowers, or use it as a simple home-decor piece. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
